What is a Bitcoin casino?

A Bitcoin casino lets you play with Bitcoin itself. You deposit BTC, keep a BTC balance, bet in BTC and withdraw BTC. Compared with a card-funded casino, three things change:

  • No bank sits between you and your deposit, so there's nothing to decline it.
  • Payouts move at network speed, not on a card processor's schedule.
  • You pay the network fee, not a card fee.

BTC casino: deposit, play and cash out in Bitcoin

BitStarz accepts Bitcoin. Send BTC to your deposit address (Lightning works for deposits), play, and withdraw in BTC to your own wallet. No fees on the way in or out. Your coins, your wallet, your call. Minimum Bitcoin deposit: 0.0001 BTC. No daily or monthly withdrawal limits. Per-transaction limits apply.
